code:
export function Area1() {
  const motion = useChartMotion()
  const data = [186, 305, 237, 273, 209, 314].map((facturado, i) => ({ mes: MESES[i], facturado: facturado * 1000 }))
  const config = { facturado: { label: "Facturado" } } satisfies ChartConfig
  return (
    <Card className="w-full max-w-lg" size="sm">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Facturado por mes</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Primer semestre, en pesos.</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <ChartContainer className="aspect-[2/1]" config={config}>
          <AreaChart data={data} margin={{ left: 4, right: 4, top: 8 }} responsive>
            <CartesianGrid vertical={false} />
            <XAxis axisLine={false} dataKey="mes" tickLine={false} tickMargin={8} />
            <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent formatter={pesos} indicator="line" />} cursor />
            <Area
              dataKey="facturado"
              fill="var(--color-facturado)"
              fillOpacity={0.1}
              stroke="var(--color-facturado)"
              strokeWidth={2}
              type="monotone"
              {...motion}
            />
          </AreaChart>
        </ChartContainer>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  )
}

code:
def escape_latex(text: str) -> str:
    
    replacements = {
        "\\": r"\textbackslash{}",
        "&": r"\&",
        "%": r"\%",
        "$": r"\$",
        "#": r"\#",
        "_": r"\_",
        "{": r"\{",
        "}": r"\}",
        "~": r"\textasciitilde{}",
        "^": r"\textasciicircum{}",
    }
    for char, escaped in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(char, escaped)
    return text

code:
def escape_latex(text: str) -> str:
    
    replacements = {
        "\\": r"\textbackslash{}",
        "&": r"\&",
        "%": r"\%",
        "$": r"\$",
        "#": r"\#",
        "_": r"\_",
        "{": r"\{",
        "}": r"\}",
        "~": r"\textasciitilde{}",
        "^": r"\textasciicircum{}",
    }
    for char, escaped in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(char, escaped)
    return text

code:
def copy_tracked_source(destination: Path) -> int:
    
    listing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    ).stdout
    copied = 0
    for raw_path in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not raw_path:
            continue
        relative = Path(os.fsdecode(raw_path))
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"git returned an unsafe tracked path: {relative}")
        source = ROOT / relative
        if not source.is_file():
            # A deleted tracked file is part of the current working tree too;
            # do not resurrect its contents from HEAD.
            continue
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        shutil.copymode(source, target)
        copied += 1
    if copied == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git returned no current tracked source files")
    return copied
comment:
"""Copy current tracked files from the repository into a destination.

Args:
    destination: Directory in which to copy the tracked files.

Returns:
    The number of files copied.

Creates destination subdirectories as needed, copies each existing tracked file,
and preserves its file mode. Deleted tracked files are skipped. Raises
RuntimeError if a tracked path is unsafe or no current tracked files are copied.
Git command failures are propagated.
"""

class INDstocksAuth:
    

    def __init__(self, cfg: INDstocksConfig):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.cfg.token_cache_path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def refresh_session(self) -> str:
        totp_code = pyotp.TOTP(self.cfg.totp_secret).now()
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{self.cfg.base_url}/generate/token",
            headers={"x-api-key": self.cfg.client_id, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={"mpin": self.cfg.mpin, "totp": totp_code},
            timeout=10,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict):
            token = body["data"]["token"]
        else:
            token = body["token"]
        self._write_cache(token)
        logger.info("INDstocks token refreshed, cached at %s", self.cfg.token_cache_path)
        return token

    def _write_cache(self, token: str) -> None:
        tmp_path = self.cfg.token_cache_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"token": token, "issued_at": time.time()}, f)
        os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
        tmp_path.replace(self.cfg.token_cache_path)  # atomic on POSIX

def f_Parse_Price(str_price_text):
    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0
    f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    try:
        # convert the text to a number
        f_price = float(str_price_text)
    except ValueError:
        # the text is not a number, keep the default price
        f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    finally:
        # the value is ready, round it to two decimals
        f_price = round(f_price, 2)
    return f_price

code:
def escape_latex(text: str) -> str:
    
    replacements = {
        "\\": r"\textbackslash{}",
        "&": r"\&",
        "%": r"\%",
        "$": r"\$",
        "#": r"\#",
        "_": r"\_",
        "{": r"\{",
        "}": r"\}",
        "~": r"\textasciitilde{}",
        "^": r"\textasciicircum{}",
    }
    for char, escaped in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(char, escaped)
    return text

code:
class INDstocksAuth:
    

    def __init__(self, cfg: INDstocksConfig):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.cfg.token_cache_path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def refresh_session(self) -> str:
        totp_code = pyotp.TOTP(self.cfg.totp_secret).now()
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{self.cfg.base_url}/generate/token",
            headers={"x-api-key": self.cfg.client_id, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={"mpin": self.cfg.mpin, "totp": totp_code},
            timeout=10,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict):
            token = body["data"]["token"]
        else:
            token = body["token"]
        self._write_cache(token)
        logger.info("INDstocks token refreshed, cached at %s", self.cfg.token_cache_path)
        return token

    def _write_cache(self, token: str) -> None:
        tmp_path = self.cfg.token_cache_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"token": token, "issued_at": time.time()}, f)
        os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
        tmp_path.replace(self.cfg.token_cache_path)  # atomic on POSIX

code:
def safe_fragment(
    value: object,
    *,
    limit: int = _MAX_FRAGMENT,
    escape_structure: bool = True,
) -> str:
    
    text = str(value)
    text = "".join(
        " " if unicodedata.category(char).startswith("C") else char
        for char in text
    )
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = _TOOL_MARKER_RE.sub("#vc‑", text)
    if escape_structure:
        text = text.translate(_STRUCTURAL_CHARS)
    if len(text) > limit:
        text = text[: max(0, limit - 1)].rstrip() + "…"
    return text
comment:
"""Convert a value to a normalized, optionally escaped text fragment.

The value is converted to a string, control-category characters are replaced
with spaces, whitespace is collapsed, and matches of the tool-marker pattern
are replaced. If `escape_structure` is true, structural characters are
translated using `_STRUCTURAL_CHARS`. Text longer than `limit` is truncated
and suffixed with an ellipsis.

Args:
    value: The value to convert.
    limit: The maximum fragment length before truncation.
    escape_structure: Whether to translate structural characters.

Returns:
    The processed text fragment.

Raises:
    Any exception raised while converting `value` to a string.
"""

code:
class INDstocksAuth:
    

    def __init__(self, cfg: INDstocksConfig):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.cfg.token_cache_path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def refresh_session(self) -> str:
        totp_code = pyotp.TOTP(self.cfg.totp_secret).now()
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{self.cfg.base_url}/generate/token",
            headers={"x-api-key": self.cfg.client_id, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={"mpin": self.cfg.mpin, "totp": totp_code},
            timeout=10,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict):
            token = body["data"]["token"]
        else:
            token = body["token"]
        self._write_cache(token)
        logger.info("INDstocks token refreshed, cached at %s", self.cfg.token_cache_path)
        return token

    def _write_cache(self, token: str) -> None:
        tmp_path = self.cfg.token_cache_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"token": token, "issued_at": time.time()}, f)
        os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
        tmp_path.replace(self.cfg.token_cache_path)  # atomic on POSIX
comment:
"""Authenticate INDstocks sessions and cache refreshed tokens.

The constructor stores the configuration and creates the token cache's parent
directory. ``refresh_session`` generates a TOTP code, requests a token, writes
it to the cache, and returns it.

Attributes:
    cfg: The INDstocks configuration.

Public methods:
    refresh_session: Request, cache, and return a session token.
"""

def f_Parse_Price(str_price_text):
    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0
    f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    try:
        # convert the text to a number
        f_price = float(str_price_text)
    except ValueError:
        # the text is not a number, keep the default price
        f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    finally:
        # the value is ready, round it to two decimals
        f_price = round(f_price, 2)
    return f_price

class INDstocksAuth:
    

    def __init__(self, cfg: INDstocksConfig):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.cfg.token_cache_path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def refresh_session(self) -> str:
        totp_code = pyotp.TOTP(self.cfg.totp_secret).now()
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{self.cfg.base_url}/generate/token",
            headers={"x-api-key": self.cfg.client_id, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={"mpin": self.cfg.mpin, "totp": totp_code},
            timeout=10,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict):
            token = body["data"]["token"]
        else:
            token = body["token"]
        self._write_cache(token)
        logger.info("INDstocks token refreshed, cached at %s", self.cfg.token_cache_path)
        return token

    def _write_cache(self, token: str) -> None:
        tmp_path = self.cfg.token_cache_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"token": token, "issued_at": time.time()}, f)
        os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
        tmp_path.replace(self.cfg.token_cache_path)  # atomic on POSIX

def escape_latex(text: str) -> str:
    
    replacements = {
        "\\": r"\textbackslash{}",
        "&": r"\&",
        "%": r"\%",
        "$": r"\$",
        "#": r"\#",
        "_": r"\_",
        "{": r"\{",
        "}": r"\}",
        "~": r"\textasciitilde{}",
        "^": r"\textasciicircum{}",
    }
    for char, escaped in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(char, escaped)
    return text

        " " if unicodedata.category(char).startswith("C") else char
        for char in text
    )
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = _TOOL_MARKER_RE.sub("#vc‑", text)
    if escape_structure:
        text = text.translate(_STRUCTURAL_CHARS)
    if len(text) > limit:
        text = text[: max(0, limit - 1)].rstrip() + "…"
    return text

code:
def safe_fragment(
    value: object,
    *,
    limit: int = _MAX_FRAGMENT,
    escape_structure: bool = True,
) -> str:
    
    text = str(value)
    text = "".join(
        " " if unicodedata.category(char).startswith("C") else char
        for char in text
    )
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = _TOOL_MARKER_RE.sub("#vc‑", text)
    if escape_structure:
        text = text.translate(_STRUCTURAL_CHARS)
    if len(text) > limit:
        text = text[: max(0, limit - 1)].rstrip() + "…"
    return text
comment:
"""Normalize and optionally escape a value for use as a fragment.

Convert the value to a string, replace Unicode category C characters with
spaces, collapse whitespace, and replace matches of the tool-marker pattern
with ``#vc‑``. When ``escape_structure`` is true, translate configured
structural characters. If the resulting text exceeds ``limit``, trim it and
append an ellipsis.

Args:
    value: Object to convert to a string.
    limit: Length threshold for truncation.
    escape_structure: Whether to translate configured structural characters.

Returns:
    The normalized fragment as a string.
"""

code:
class INDstocksAuth:
    

    def __init__(self, cfg: INDstocksConfig):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.cfg.token_cache_path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def refresh_session(self) -> str:
        totp_code = pyotp.TOTP(self.cfg.totp_secret).now()
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{self.cfg.base_url}/generate/token",
            headers={"x-api-key": self.cfg.client_id, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={"mpin": self.cfg.mpin, "totp": totp_code},
            timeout=10,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict):
            token = body["data"]["token"]
        else:
            token = body["token"]
        self._write_cache(token)
        logger.info("INDstocks token refreshed, cached at %s", self.cfg.token_cache_path)
        return token

    def _write_cache(self, token: str) -> None:
        tmp_path = self.cfg.token_cache_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"token": token, "issued_at": time.time()}, f)
        os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
        tmp_path.replace(self.cfg.token_cache_path)  # atomic on POSIX

code:
def copy_tracked_source(destination: Path) -> int:
    
    listing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    ).stdout
    copied = 0
    for raw_path in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not raw_path:
            continue
        relative = Path(os.fsdecode(raw_path))
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"git returned an unsafe tracked path: {relative}")
        source = ROOT / relative
        if not source.is_file():
            # A deleted tracked file is part of the current working tree too;
            # do not resurrect its contents from HEAD.
            continue
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        shutil.copymode(source, target)
        copied += 1
    if copied == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git returned no current tracked source files")
    return copied
comment:
"""Copy existing Git-tracked files from the repository to a destination.

Files missing from the working tree are skipped. Destination directories are
created as needed, and copied files retain their source permission bits.

Args:
    destination: Directory in which to copy the tracked files.

Returns:
    The number of files copied.

Raises:
    RuntimeError: If a tracked path is unsafe or no current tracked files are
        copied.
"""

rules.description: Public functions should have a docstring describing their behavior. Per PEP 257 it should cover arguments, return value, side effects, and exceptions where applicable, but no specific markup style (e.g. Google-style Args:/Returns: sections) is mandated by PEP 8 or PEP 257 — the content, not the format, is the requirement.

code:
def copy_tracked_source(destination: Path) -> int:
    
    listing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    ).stdout
    copied = 0
    for raw_path in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not raw_path:
            continue
        relative = Path(os.fsdecode(raw_path))
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"git returned an unsafe tracked path: {relative}")
        source = ROOT / relative
        if not source.is_file():
            # A deleted tracked file is part of the current working tree too;
            # do not resurrect its contents from HEAD.
            continue
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        shutil.copymode(source, target)
        copied += 1
    if copied == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git returned no current tracked source files")
    return copied
comment:
"""Copy current tracked files from the repository into a destination.

Lists tracked paths with Git from ROOT, skips paths that are not current files,
and copies each remaining file's contents and mode under destination, creating
parent directories as needed.

Returns:
    The number of files copied.

Raises:
    RuntimeError: If Git reports an unsafe path or no current tracked source
        files are copied.
"""

@router.post(
    "/events/{slug}/projects/{pid}/votes",
    status_code=201,
    dependencies=[Depends(limiter("vote", 30, 60))],
)
def cast_vote(
    request: Request,
    pid: str,
    ctx: EventContext = Depends(load_event),
    voter: Voter | None = Depends(current_voter),
    db: DbSession = Depends(get_db),
    settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings),
):
    
    project = projects_service.get_project(db, ctx.event, pid, ctx.user, organizer=ctx.is_organizer)
    new_cookie = None
    if voter is None and ctx.event.voting_mode.value == "link":
        voter_id, new_cookie = voting_service.new_voter_cookie(settings.secret_key)
        voter = Voter(key=f"anon:{voter_id}", mode=ctx.event.voting_mode)
    if voter is None:
        raise Unauthorized("Sign in or redeem a voting code to vote in this event.")
    voting_service.cast(
        db, ctx.event, project, voter, ip_hash=ip_hash(request), ua_hash=ua_hash(request)
    )
    response = JSONResponse({"vote": _vote_out(ctx.event, project, voter, db)}, status_code=201)
    if new_cookie:
        response.set_cookie(
            VOTER_COOKIE,
            new_cookie,
            httponly=True,
            samesite="lax",
            secure=settings.secure_cookies,
            max_age=60 * 60 * 24 * 90,
            path="/",
        )
    return response

code:
def copy_tracked_source(destination: Path) -> int:
    
    listing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    ).stdout
    copied = 0
    for raw_path in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not raw_path:
            continue
        relative = Path(os.fsdecode(raw_path))
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"git returned an unsafe tracked path: {relative}")
        source = ROOT / relative
        if not source.is_file():
            # A deleted tracked file is part of the current working tree too;
            # do not resurrect its contents from HEAD.
            continue
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        shutil.copymode(source, target)
        copied += 1
    if copied == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git returned no current tracked source files")
    return copied
comment:
"""Copy current tracked files from the repository into a destination.

Args:
    destination: Directory to receive copies of the tracked files.

Returns:
    The number of files copied.

Raises:
    RuntimeError: If Git returns an unsafe tracked path or no current tracked
        source files are available.
    subprocess.CalledProcessError: If the Git command fails.

Creates destination subdirectories as needed, copies each current tracked file,
and preserves its file mode. Tracked files that are missing from the working tree
are skipped. Filesystem errors during copying or directory creation may also
propagate.
"""

code:
@router.post(
    "/events/{slug}/projects/{pid}/votes",
    status_code=201,
    dependencies=[Depends(limiter("vote", 30, 60))],
)
def cast_vote(
    request: Request,
    pid: str,
    ctx: EventContext = Depends(load_event),
    voter: Voter | None = Depends(current_voter),
    db: DbSession = Depends(get_db),
    settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings),
):
    
    project = projects_service.get_project(db, ctx.event, pid, ctx.user, organizer=ctx.is_organizer)
    new_cookie = None
    if voter is None and ctx.event.voting_mode.value == "link":
        voter_id, new_cookie = voting_service.new_voter_cookie(settings.secret_key)
        voter = Voter(key=f"anon:{voter_id}", mode=ctx.event.voting_mode)
    if voter is None:
        raise Unauthorized("Sign in or redeem a voting code to vote in this event.")
    voting_service.cast(
        db, ctx.event, project, voter, ip_hash=ip_hash(request), ua_hash=ua_hash(request)
    )
    response = JSONResponse({"vote": _vote_out(ctx.event, project, voter, db)}, status_code=201)
    if new_cookie:
        response.set_cookie(
            VOTER_COOKIE,
            new_cookie,
            httponly=True,
            samesite="lax",
            secure=settings.secure_cookies,
            max_age=60 * 60 * 24 * 90,
            path="/",
        )
    return response
comment:
"""Cast a vote for a project in the current event.

    Args:
        request: Request used to derive IP and user-agent hashes.
        pid: ID of the project to vote for.
        ctx: Context for the current event and user.
        voter: Voter casting the vote, if available.
        db: Database session.
        settings: Application settings used to create and configure a voter cookie.

    Returns:
        A 201 JSON response containing the vote; when an anonymous link-mode
        voter is created, the response also includes its cookie.

    Raises:
        Unauthorized: If no voter is available and one cannot be created for
            link-mode voting.

    Side effects:
        Records the vote in the database and may set a voter cookie on the
        response.
    """

code:
def copy_tracked_source(destination: Path) -> int:
    
    listing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    ).stdout
    copied = 0
    for raw_path in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not raw_path:
            continue
        relative = Path(os.fsdecode(raw_path))
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"git returned an unsafe tracked path: {relative}")
        source = ROOT / relative
        if not source.is_file():
            # A deleted tracked file is part of the current working tree too;
            # do not resurrect its contents from HEAD.
            continue
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        shutil.copymode(source, target)
        copied += 1
    if copied == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git returned no current tracked source files")
    return copied
comment:
"""Copy current tracked source files into the destination.

    Args:
        destination: Directory in which to copy the tracked files.

    Returns:
        The number of files copied.

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: If Git returns an unsafe path or no current tracked
            source files. Subprocess errors are also raised if listing tracked
            files fails.

    Creates parent directories as needed and preserves each copied file's
    mode. Tracked files that are missing from the working tree are skipped.
    """

class INDstocksAuth:
    

    def __init__(self, cfg: INDstocksConfig):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.cfg.token_cache_path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def refresh_session(self) -> str:
        totp_code = pyotp.TOTP(self.cfg.totp_secret).now()
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{self.cfg.base_url}/generate/token",
            headers={"x-api-key": self.cfg.client_id, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={"mpin": self.cfg.mpin, "totp": totp_code},
            timeout=10,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict):
            token = body["data"]["token"]
        else:
            token = body["token"]
        self._write_cache(token)
        logger.info("INDstocks token refreshed, cached at %s", self.cfg.token_cache_path)
        return token

    def _write_cache(self, token: str) -> None:
        tmp_path = self.cfg.token_cache_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"token": token, "issued_at": time.time()}, f)
        os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
        tmp_path.replace(self.cfg.token_cache_path)  # atomic on POSIX

def escape_latex(text: str) -> str:
    
    replacements = {

        "&": r"\&",
        "%": r"\%",
        "$": r"\$",
        "#": r"\#",
        "_": r"\_",
        "{": r"\{",
        "}": r"\}",
        "~": r"\textasciitilde{}",
        "^": r"\textasciicircum{}",
    }
    for char, escaped in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(char, escaped)
    return text

rules.description: Public functions should have a docstring describing their behavior. code:
def copy_tracked_source(destination: Path) -> int:
    
    listing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    ).stdout
    copied = 0
    for raw_path in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not raw_path:
            continue
        relative = Path(os.fsdecode(raw_path))
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"git returned an unsafe tracked path: {relative}")
        source = ROOT / relative
        if not source.is_file():
            # A deleted tracked file is part of the current working tree too;
            # do not resurrect its contents from HEAD.
            continue
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        shutil.copymode(source, target)
        copied += 1
    if copied == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git returned no current tracked source files")
    return copied
comment: """Copy current bytes for tracked paths into an isolated source tree."""

@router.post(
    "/events/{slug}/projects/{pid}/votes",
    status_code=201,
    dependencies=[Depends(limiter("vote", 30, 60))],
)
def cast_vote(
    request: Request,
    pid: str,
    ctx: EventContext = Depends(load_event),
    voter: Voter | None = Depends(current_voter),
    db: DbSession = Depends(get_db),
    settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings),
):
    
    project = projects_service.get_project(db, ctx.event, pid, ctx.user, organizer=ctx.is_organizer)
    new_cookie = None
    if voter is None and ctx.event.voting_mode.value == "link":
        voter_id, new_cookie = voting_service.new_voter_cookie(settings.secret_key)
        voter = Voter(key=f"anon:{voter_id}", mode=ctx.event.voting_mode)
    if voter is None:
        raise Unauthorized("Sign in or redeem a voting code to vote in this event.")
    voting_service.cast(
        db, ctx.event, project, voter, ip_hash=ip_hash(request), ua_hash=ua_hash(request)
    )
    response = JSONResponse({"vote": _vote_out(ctx.event, project, voter, db)}, status_code=201)
    if new_cookie:
        response.set_cookie(
            VOTER_COOKIE,
            new_cookie,
            httponly=True,
            samesite="lax",
            secure=settings.secure_cookies,
            max_age=60 * 60 * 24 * 90,
            path="/",
        )
    return response

code:
def safe_fragment(
    value: object,
    *,
    limit: int = _MAX_FRAGMENT,
    escape_structure: bool = True,
) -> str:
    
    text = str(value)
    text = "".join(
        " " if unicodedata.category(char).startswith("C") else char
        for char in text
    )
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = _TOOL_MARKER_RE.sub("#vc‑", text)
    if escape_structure:
        text = text.translate(_STRUCTURAL_CHARS)
    if len(text) > limit:

class INDstocksAuth:
    

    def __init__(self, cfg: INDstocksConfig):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.cfg.token_cache_path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def refresh_session(self) -> str:
        totp_code = pyotp.TOTP(self.cfg.totp_secret).now()
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{self.cfg.base_url}/generate/token",
            headers={"x-api-key": self.cfg.client_id, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={"mpin": self.cfg.mpin, "totp": totp_code},
            timeout=10,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict):
            token = body["data"]["token"]
        else:
            token = body["token"]
        self._write_cache(token)
        logger.info("INDstocks token refreshed, cached at %s", self.cfg.token_cache_path)
        return token

    def _write_cache(self, token: str) -> None:
        tmp_path = self.cfg.token_cache_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"token": token, "issued_at": time.time()}, f)
        os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
        tmp_path.replace(self.cfg.token_cache_path)  # atomic on POSIX

def f_Parse_Price(str_price_text):
    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0

    try:

        f_price = float(str_price_text)

code:
def copy_tracked_source(destination: Path) -> int:
    
    listing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    ).stdout
    copied = 0
    for raw_path in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not raw_path:
            continue
        relative = Path(os.fsdecode(raw_path))
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"git returned an unsafe tracked path: {relative}")
        source = ROOT / relative
        if not source.is_file():
            # A deleted tracked file is part of the current working tree too;
            # do not resurrect its contents from HEAD.
            continue
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        shutil.copymode(source, target)
        copied += 1
    if copied == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git returned no current tracked source files")
    return copied
comment:
"""Copy current tracked source files into the destination.

    Args:
        destination: Directory in which to copy the tracked files.

    Returns:
        The number of files copied.

    Creates parent directories as needed and preserves each copied file's mode.
    Skips tracked paths that are not current files. Raises RuntimeError if Git
    reports an unsafe path or no current tracked files; subprocess and filesystem
    errors may also propagate.
    """

def f_Parse_Price(str_price_text):
    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0
    f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    try:
        # convert the text to a number
        f_price = float(str_price_text)
    except ValueError:
        # the text is not a number, keep the default price
        f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    finally:
        # the value is ready, round it to two decimals
        f_price = round(f_price, 2)
    return f_price

@router.post(
    "/events/{slug}/projects/{pid}/votes",
    status_code=201,
    dependencies=[Depends(limiter("vote", 30, 60))],
)
def cast_vote(
    request: Request,
    pid: str,
    ctx: EventContext = Depends(load_event),
    voter: Voter | None = Depends(current_voter),
    db: DbSession = Depends(get_db),
    settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings),
):
    
    project = projects_service.get_project(db, ctx.event, pid, ctx.user, organizer=ctx.is_organizer)
    new_cookie = None
    if voter is None and ctx.event.voting_mode.value == "link":
        voter_id, new_cookie = voting_service.new_voter_cookie(settings.secret_key)
        voter = Voter(key=f"anon:{voter_id}", mode=ctx.event.voting_mode)
    if voter is None:
        raise Unauthorized("Sign in or redeem a voting code to vote in this event.")
    voting_service.cast(
        db, ctx.event, project, voter, ip_hash=ip_hash(request), ua_hash=ua_hash(request)
    )
    response = JSONResponse({"vote": _vote_out(ctx.event, project, voter, db)}, status_code=201)
    if new_cookie:
        response.set_cookie(
            VOTER_COOKIE,
            new_cookie,
            httponly=True,
            samesite="lax",
            secure=settings.secure_cookies,
            max_age=60 * 60 * 24 * 90,
            path="/",
        )
    return response

def f_Parse_Price(str_price_text):
    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0
    f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    try:
        # convert the text to a number
        f_price = float(str_price_text)
    except ValueError:
        # the text is not a number, keep the default price
        f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    finally:
        # the value is ready, round it to two decimals
        f_price = round(f_price, 2)
    return f_price

rules.description: Public functions should have a docstring describing their behavior. Per PEP 257 it should cover arguments, return value, side effects, and exceptions where applicable, but no specific markup style (e.g. Google-style Args:/Returns: sections) is mandated by PEP 8 or PEP 257 — the content, not the format, is the requirement.

code:
def safe_fragment(
    value: object,
    *,
    limit: int = _MAX_FRAGMENT,
    escape_structure: bool = True,
) -> str:
    
    text = str(value)
    text = "".join(
        " " if unicodedata.category(char).startswith("C") else char
        for char in text
    )
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = _TOOL_MARKER_RE.sub("#vc‑", text)
    if escape_structure:
        text = text.translate(_STRUCTURAL_CHARS)
    if len(text) > limit:
        text = text[: max(0, limit - 1)].rstrip() + "…"
    return text
comment:
"""Normalize and optionally escape a value to produce a safe text fragment.

Args:
    value: The object converted to text and processed.
    limit: The maximum fragment length before truncation; a Unicode ellipsis
        is appended when the processed text exceeds this limit.
    escape_structure: Whether to translate structural characters using the
        configured mapping.

Returns:
    The processed text, with control-category characters replaced by spaces,
    whitespace collapsed, and tool markers replaced. The result is truncated
    to the limit when necessary.

Any exception raised while converting value to text propagates to the caller.
"""

def f_Parse_Price(str_price_text):
    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0
    f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    try:
        # convert the text to a number
        f_price = float(str_price_text)
    except ValueError:
        # the text is not a number, keep the default price
        f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    finally:
        # the value is ready, round it to two decimals
        f_price = round(f_price, 2)
    return f_price

code:
def escape_latex(text: str) -> str:
    
    replacements = {
        "\\": r"\textbackslash{}",
        "&": r"\&",
        "%": r"\%",
        "$": r"\$",
        "#": r"\#",
        "_": r"\_",
        "{": r"\{",
        "}": r"\}",
        "~": r"\textasciitilde{}",
        "^": r"\textasciicircum{}",
    }
    for char, escaped in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(char, escaped)
    return text

code:
def copy_tracked_source(destination: Path) -> int:
    
    listing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    ).stdout
    copied = 0
    for raw_path in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not raw_path:
            continue
        relative = Path(os.fsdecode(raw_path))
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"git returned an unsafe tracked path: {relative}")
        source = ROOT / relative
        if not source.is_file():
            # A deleted tracked file is part of the current working tree too;
            # do not resurrect its contents from HEAD.
            continue
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        shutil.copymode(source, target)
        copied += 1
    if copied == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git returned no current tracked source files")
    return copied
comment:
"""Copy current tracked files from the repository into a destination.

    Args:
        destination: Directory where tracked files are copied, preserving their
            relative paths and file modes.

    Returns:
        The number of files copied.

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: If Git returns an unsafe tracked path or no current
            tracked source files are copied.
        subprocess.CalledProcessError: If listing tracked files with Git fails.
    """

code:
@router.post(
    "/events/{slug}/projects/{pid}/votes",
    status_code=201,
    dependencies=[Depends(limiter("vote", 30, 60))],
)
def cast_vote(
    request: Request,
    pid: str,
    ctx: EventContext = Depends(load_event),
    voter: Voter | None = Depends(current_voter),
    db: DbSession = Depends(get_db),
    settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings),
):
    
    project = projects_service.get_project(db, ctx.event, pid, ctx.user, organizer=ctx.is_organizer)
    new_cookie = None
    if voter is None and ctx.event.voting_mode.value == "link":
        voter_id, new_cookie = voting_service.new_voter_cookie(settings.secret_key)
        voter = Voter(key=f"anon:{voter_id}", mode=ctx.event.voting_mode)
    if voter is None:
        raise Unauthorized("Sign in or redeem a voting code to vote in this event.")
    voting_service.cast(
        db, ctx.event, project, voter, ip_hash=ip_hash(request), ua_hash=ua_hash(request)
    )
    response = JSONResponse({"vote": _vote_out(ctx.event, project, voter, db)}, status_code=201)
    if new_cookie:
        response.set_cookie(
            VOTER_COOKIE,
            new_cookie,
            httponly=True,
            samesite="lax",
            secure=settings.secure_cookies,
            max_age=60 * 60 * 24 * 90,
            path="/",
        )
    return response

"""Cast a vote for a project in the current event.

Args:
    request: The request used to derive voter IP and user-agent hashes.
    pid: The project identifier.
    ctx: The current event context.
    voter: The current voter, if one is available.
    db: The database session.
    settings: Application settings used to sign and configure a voter cookie.

Returns:
    A JSON response containing the vote, with status code 201. When a new
    anonymous voter is created for link-mode voting, the response also sets
    its voter cookie.

Raises:
    Unauthorized: If no voter is available and link-mode voting does not
        provide an anonymous voter.

Side effects:
    Casts the vote and may set a voter cookie on the response.
"""

def f_Parse_Price(str_price_text):
    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0
    f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    try:
        # convert the text to a number
        f_price = float(str_price_text)
    except ValueError:
        # the text is not a number, keep the default price
        f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    finally:
        # the value is ready, round it to two decimals
        f_price = round(f_price, 2)
    return f_price

rules.description: Public functions should have a docstring describing their behavior. Per PEP 257 it should cover arguments, return value, side effects, and exceptions where applicable, but no specific markup style (e.g. Google-style Args:/Returns: sections) is mandated by PEP 8 or PEP 257 — the content, not the format, is the requirement.

code:
def copy_tracked_source(destination: Path) -> int:
    
    listing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    ).stdout
    copied = 0
    for raw_path in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not raw_path:
            continue
        relative = Path(os.fsdecode(raw_path))
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"git returned an unsafe tracked path: {relative}")
        source = ROOT / relative
        if not source.is_file():
            # A deleted tracked file is part of the current working tree too;
            # do not resurrect its contents from HEAD.
            continue
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        shutil.copymode(source, target)
        copied += 1
    if copied == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git returned no current tracked source files")
    return copied
comment:
"""Copy existing tracked files from the repository to a destination.

Run ``git ls-files`` in ``ROOT`` and copy each existing tracked file to
``destination``, preserving its file mode. Deleted tracked files are
skipped.

Args:
    destination: Directory in which to copy the tracked files.

Returns:
    The number of files copied.

Raises:
    RuntimeError: If Git returns an unsafe tracked path or no existing
        tracked files are copied.
    subprocess.CalledProcessError: If the Git command fails.
"""

rules.description: Public classes should have a docstring summarizing the class's behavior; PEP 257 additionally suggests listing public methods and instance variables, but prescribes no required markup syntax for how that content is formatted.

code:
class INDstocksAuth:
    

    def __init__(self, cfg: INDstocksConfig):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.cfg.token_cache_path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def refresh_session(self) -> str:
        totp_code = pyotp.TOTP(self.cfg.totp_secret).now()
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{self.cfg.base_url}/generate/token",
            headers={"x-api-key": self.cfg.client_id, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={"mpin": self.cfg.mpin, "totp": totp_code},
            timeout=10,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict):
            token = body["data"]["token"]
        else:
            token = body["token"]
        self._write_cache(token)
        logger.info("INDstocks token refreshed, cached at %s", self.cfg.token_cache_path)
        return token

    def _write_cache(self, token: str) -> None:
        tmp_path = self.cfg.token_cache_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"token": token, "issued_at": time.time()}, f)
        os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
        tmp_path.replace(self.cfg.token_cache_path)  # atomic on POSIX
comment: """Owns TOTP-based token generation. Run from a single process only."""

def escape_latex(text: str) -> str:
    
    replacements = {
        "\\": r"\textbackslash{}",
        "&": r"\&",
        "%": r"\%",
        "$": r"\$",
        "#": r"\#",
        "_": r"\_",
        "{": r"\{",
        "}": r"\}",
        "~": r"\textasciitilde{}",
        "^": r"\textasciicircum{}",
    }
    for char, escaped in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(char, escaped)
    return text

code:
def safe_fragment(
    value: object,
    *,
    limit: int = _MAX_FRAGMENT,
    escape_structure: bool = True,
) -> str:
    
    text = str(value)
    text = "".join(
        " " if unicodedata.category(char).startswith("C") else char
        for char in text
    )
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = _TOOL_MARKER_RE.sub("#vc‑", text)
    if escape_structure:
        text = text.translate(_STRUCTURAL_CHARS)
    if len(text) > limit:
        text = text[: max(0, limit - 1)].rstrip() + "…"
    return text
comment:
"""Normalize a value into a text fragment, optionally escaping structure.

    Converts value to a string, replaces Unicode characters in category C with
    spaces, collapses whitespace, and rewrites tool markers to ``#vc‑``. When
    escape_structure is true, translates structural characters using
    ``_STRUCTURAL_CHARS``. If the result exceeds limit, keeps a prefix of length
    max(0, limit - 1), strips trailing whitespace from it, and appends an
    ellipsis.

    Args:
        value: The value to convert to a fragment.
        limit: The length threshold that triggers truncation.
        escape_structure: Whether to translate structural characters.

    Returns:
        The normalized fragment as a string.
    """

    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0

    finally:
        # the value is ready, round it to two decimals

@router.post(
    "/events/{slug}/projects/{pid}/votes",
    status_code=201,
    dependencies=[Depends(limiter("vote", 30, 60))],
)
def cast_vote(
    request: Request,
    pid: str,
    ctx: EventContext = Depends(load_event),
    voter: Voter | None = Depends(current_voter),
    db: DbSession = Depends(get_db),
    settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings),
):
    
    project = projects_service.get_project(db, ctx.event, pid, ctx.user, organizer=ctx.is_organizer)
    new_cookie = None
    if voter is None and ctx.event.voting_mode.value == "link":
        voter_id, new_cookie = voting_service.new_voter_cookie(settings.secret_key)
        voter = Voter(key=f"anon:{voter_id}", mode=ctx.event.voting_mode)
    if voter is None:
        raise Unauthorized("Sign in or redeem a voting code to vote in this event.")
    voting_service.cast(
        db, ctx.event, project, voter, ip_hash=ip_hash(request), ua_hash=ua_hash(request)
    )
    response = JSONResponse({"vote": _vote_out(ctx.event, project, voter, db)}, status_code=201)
    if new_cookie:
        response.set_cookie(
            VOTER_COOKIE,
            new_cookie,
            httponly=True,
            samesite="lax",
            secure=settings.secure_cookies,
            max_age=60 * 60 * 24 * 90,
            path="/",
        )
    return response

code:
def safe_fragment(
    value: object,
    *,
    limit: int = _MAX_FRAGMENT,
    escape_structure: bool = True,
) -> str:
    
    text = str(value)
    text = "".join(
        " " if unicodedata.category(char).startswith("C") else char
        for char in text
    )
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = _TOOL_MARKER_RE.sub("#vc‑", text)
    if escape_structure:
        text = text.translate(_STRUCTURAL_CHARS)
    if len(text) > limit:
        text = text[: max(0, limit - 1)].rstrip() + "…"
    return text
comment:
"""Create a normalized, optionally structure-escaped string fragment.

Args:
    value: Object converted to a string before processing.
    limit: Length threshold at which the fragment is truncated.
    escape_structure: Whether to translate configured structural characters.

Returns:
    The processed string, with control-category characters replaced by spaces,
    whitespace collapsed, tool-marker matches replaced, and, when enabled,
    structural characters translated. If the resulting string exceeds limit,
    a truncated prefix followed by an ellipsis is returned.

Raises:
    Any exception raised while converting or processing the value or limit.
"""

def safe_fragment(
    value: object,
    *,
    limit: int = _MAX_FRAGMENT,
    escape_structure: bool = True,
) -> str:
    
    text = str(value)
    text = "".join(
        " " if unicodedata.category(char).startswith("C") else char
        for char in text
    )
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = _TOOL_MARKER_RE.sub("#vc‑", text)
    if escape_structure:
        text = text.translate(_STRUCTURAL_CHARS)
    if len(text) > limit:
        text = text[: max(0, limit - 1)].rstrip() + "…"
    return text

def f_Parse_Price(str_price_text):
    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0
    f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    try:
        # convert the text to a number
        f_price = float(str_price_text)
    except ValueError:
        # the text is not a number, keep the default price
        f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    finally:
        # the value is ready, round it to two decimals
        f_price = round(f_price, 2)
    return f_price

code:
def safe_fragment(
    value: object,
    *,
    limit: int = _MAX_FRAGMENT,
    escape_structure: bool = True,
) -> str:
    
    text = str(value)
    text = "".join(
        " " if unicodedata.category(char).startswith("C") else char
        for char in text
    )
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = _TOOL_MARKER_RE.sub("#vc‑", text)
    if escape_structure:
        text = text.translate(_STRUCTURAL_CHARS)
    if len(text) > limit:

comment:
"""Return a normalized, optionally escaped fragment of ``value``.

The value is converted to text; characters whose Unicode category begins
with ``C`` are replaced with spaces, and whitespace is collapsed. Matches
of the tool-marker pattern are replaced with ``#vc‑``. Structural
characters are translated when ``escape_structure`` is true.

If the resulting text is longer than ``limit``, it is truncated to at
most ``max(0, limit - 1)`` characters, trailing whitespace is removed,
and an ellipsis is appended.

Args:
    value: The object to convert to text.
    limit: The length threshold for truncating the resulting text.
    escape_structure: Whether to translate structural characters.

Returns:
    The normalized fragment as a string.
"""

code:
@router.post(
    "/events/{slug}/projects/{pid}/votes",
    status_code=201,
    dependencies=[Depends(limiter("vote", 30, 60))],
)
def cast_vote(
    request: Request,
    pid: str,
    ctx: EventContext = Depends(load_event),
    voter: Voter | None = Depends(current_voter),
    db: DbSession = Depends(get_db),
    settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings),
):
    
    project = projects_service.get_project(db, ctx.event, pid, ctx.user, organizer=ctx.is_organizer)
    new_cookie = None
    if voter is None and ctx.event.voting_mode.value == "link":
        voter_id, new_cookie = voting_service.new_voter_cookie(settings.secret_key)
        voter = Voter(key=f"anon:{voter_id}", mode=ctx.event.voting_mode)
    if voter is None:
        raise Unauthorized("Sign in or redeem a voting code to vote in this event.")
    voting_service.cast(
        db, ctx.event, project, voter, ip_hash=ip_hash(request), ua_hash=ua_hash(request)
    )
    response = JSONResponse({"vote": _vote_out(ctx.event, project, voter, db)}, status_code=201)
    if new_cookie:
        response.set_cookie(
            VOTER_COOKIE,
            new_cookie,
            httponly=True,
            samesite="lax",
            secure=settings.secure_cookies,
            max_age=60 * 60 * 24 * 90,
            path="/",
        )
    return response

"""Record a vote for a project in an event.

Args:
    request: The request used to derive the voter's IP and user-agent hashes.
    pid: The project identifier.
    ctx: The event context, including the current user and organizer status.
    voter: The current voter, if one is available.
    db: The database session used for project lookup and voting.
    settings: Settings used to create and configure a voter cookie.

Returns:
    A JSON response containing the vote, with status code 201. If a new
    anonymous voter cookie was created, the response sets that cookie.

Raises:
    Unauthorized: If no voter is available and the event does not allow
        creating an anonymous voter through link voting mode.

This function looks up the project, creates an anonymous voter when link
voting is enabled and no voter is available, and records the vote using
hashes of the request IP and user agent."""

code:
class INDstocksAuth:
    

    def __init__(self, cfg: INDstocksConfig):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.cfg.token_cache_path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def refresh_session(self) -> str:
        totp_code = pyotp.TOTP(self.cfg.totp_secret).now()
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{self.cfg.base_url}/generate/token",
            headers={"x-api-key": self.cfg.client_id, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={"mpin": self.cfg.mpin, "totp": totp_code},
            timeout=10,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict):
            token = body["data"]["token"]
        else:
            token = body["token"]
        self._write_cache(token)
        logger.info("INDstocks token refreshed, cached at %s", self.cfg.token_cache_path)
        return token

    def _write_cache(self, token: str) -> None:
        tmp_path = self.cfg.token_cache_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"token": token, "issued_at": time.time()}, f)
        os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
        tmp_path.replace(self.cfg.token_cache_path)  # atomic on POSIX

def escape_latex(text: str) -> str:
    
    replacements = {
        "\\": r"\textbackslash{}",
        "&": r"\&",
        "%": r"\%",
        "$": r"\$",
        "#": r"\#",
        "_": r"\_",
        "{": r"\{",
        "}": r"\}",
        "~": r"\textasciitilde{}",
        "^": r"\textasciicircum{}",
    }
    for char, escaped in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(char, escaped)
    return text

def f_Parse_Price(str_price_text):
    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0
    f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    try:
        # convert the text to a number
        f_price = float(str_price_text)
    except ValueError:
        # the text is not a number, keep the default price
        f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    finally:
        # the value is ready, round it to two decimals
        f_price = round(f_price, 2)
    return f_price

code:
def safe_fragment(
    value: object,
    *,
    limit: int = _MAX_FRAGMENT,
    escape_structure: bool = True,
) -> str:
    
    text = str(value)
    text = "".join(
        " " if unicodedata.category(char).startswith("C") else char
        for char in text
    )
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = _TOOL_MARKER_RE.sub("#vc‑", text)
    if escape_structure:
        text = text.translate(_STRUCTURAL_CHARS)
    if len(text) > limit:
        text = text[: max(0, limit - 1)].rstrip() + "…"
    return text
comment:
"""Create a normalized, optionally escaped fragment from a value.

Args:
    value: The object to convert to text.
    limit: The length threshold at which to truncate the fragment.
    escape_structure: Whether to translate structural characters.

Returns:
    The processed text, with an ellipsis appended when its length exceeds
    ``limit``.

Converts ``value`` to a string, replaces Unicode control-category characters
with spaces, collapses whitespace, and replaces tool markers. When
``escape_structure`` is true, translates structural characters as specified
by ``_STRUCTURAL_CHARS``. Converting ``value`` to a string may raise an
exception from its string conversion method.
"""

def f_Parse_Price(str_price_text):
    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0
    f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    try:

@router.post(
    "/events/{slug}/projects/{pid}/votes",
    status_code=201,
    dependencies=[Depends(limiter("vote", 30, 60))],
)
def cast_vote(
    request: Request,
    pid: str,
    ctx: EventContext = Depends(load_event),
    voter: Voter | None = Depends(current_voter),
    db: DbSession = Depends(get_db),
    settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings),
):
    
    project = projects_service.get_project(db, ctx.event, pid, ctx.user, organizer=ctx.is_organizer)
    new_cookie = None
    if voter is None and ctx.event.voting_mode.value == "link":
        voter_id, new_cookie = voting_service.new_voter_cookie(settings.secret_key)
        voter = Voter(key=f"anon:{voter_id}", mode=ctx.event.voting_mode)
    if voter is None:
        raise Unauthorized("Sign in or redeem a voting code to vote in this event.")
    voting_service.cast(
        db, ctx.event, project, voter, ip_hash=ip_hash(request), ua_hash=ua_hash(request)
    )
    response = JSONResponse({"vote": _vote_out(ctx.event, project, voter, db)}, status_code=201)
    if new_cookie:
        response.set_cookie(
            VOTER_COOKIE,
            new_cookie,
            httponly=True,
            samesite="lax",
            secure=settings.secure_cookies,
            max_age=60 * 60 * 24 * 90,
            path="/",
        )
    return response

rules.description: Public functions should have a docstring describing their behavior. Per PEP 257 it should cover arguments, return value, side effects, and exceptions where applicable, but no specific markup style (e.g. Google-style Args:/Returns: sections) is mandated by PEP 8 or PEP 257 — the content, not the format, is the requirement.

code:
def copy_tracked_source(destination: Path) -> int:
    
    listing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    ).stdout
    copied = 0
    for raw_path in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not raw_path:
            continue
        relative = Path(os.fsdecode(raw_path))
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"git returned an unsafe tracked path: {relative}")
        source = ROOT / relative
        if not source.is_file():
            # A deleted tracked file is part of the current working tree too;
            # do not resurrect its contents from HEAD.
            continue
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        shutil.copymode(source, target)
        copied += 1
    if copied == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git returned no current tracked source files")
    return copied
comment:
"""Copy current tracked source files into the destination.

    Args:
        destination: Directory where tracked files are copied, preserving their
            relative paths.

    Returns:
        The number of files copied.

    Raises:
        subprocess.CalledProcessError: If the Git command fails.
        RuntimeError: If Git returns an unsafe path or no current tracked
            source files are copied.

    Creates parent directories as needed. Tracked files missing from the
    current working tree are skipped.
    """

rules.description: Public functions should have a docstring describing their behavior. code:
def copy_tracked_source(destination: Path) -> int:
    
    listing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    ).stdout
    copied = 0
    for raw_path in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not raw_path:
            continue
        relative = Path(os.fsdecode(raw_path))
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"git returned an unsafe tracked path: {relative}")
        source = ROOT / relative
        if not source.is_file():
            # A deleted tracked file is part of the current working tree too;
            # do not resurrect its contents from HEAD.
            continue
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        shutil.copymode(source, target)
        copied += 1
    if copied == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git returned no current tracked source files")
    return copied
comment:
"""Copy current tracked files from ``ROOT`` into ``destination``.

Tracked paths are obtained with ``git ls-files``. Files missing from the
working tree are skipped, and copied files retain their source permissions.

Args:
    destination: Directory into which files are copied, preserving their paths.

Returns:
    The number of files copied.

Raises:
    RuntimeError: If a tracked path is unsafe or no files are copied.
"""

code:
def copy_tracked_source(destination: Path) -> int:
    
    listing = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
    ).stdout
    copied = 0
    for raw_path in listing.split(b"\0"):
        if not raw_path:
            continue
        relative = Path(os.fsdecode(raw_path))
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"git returned an unsafe tracked path: {relative}")
        source = ROOT / relative
        if not source.is_file():
            # A deleted tracked file is part of the current working tree too;
            # do not resurrect its contents from HEAD.
            continue
        target = destination / relative
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(source, target)
        shutil.copymode(source, target)
        copied += 1
    if copied == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git returned no current tracked source files")
    return copied
comment:
"""Copy existing Git-tracked files from the repository to a destination.

Files are copied using their paths relative to the repository root, and their
file modes are preserved. Tracked paths that do not exist as files are skipped.

Args:
    destination: Directory in which to copy the tracked files.

Returns:
    The number of files copied.

Raises:
    subprocess.CalledProcessError: If the Git command fails.
    RuntimeError: If Git returns an unsafe path or no current tracked files
        are copied.
"""

@router.post(
    "/events/{slug}/projects/{pid}/votes",
    status_code=201,
    dependencies=[Depends(limiter("vote", 30, 60))],
)
def cast_vote(
    request: Request,
    pid: str,
    ctx: EventContext = Depends(load_event),
    voter: Voter | None = Depends(current_voter),
    db: DbSession = Depends(get_db),
    settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings),
):
    
    project = projects_service.get_project(db, ctx.event, pid, ctx.user, organizer=ctx.is_organizer)
    new_cookie = None
    if voter is None and ctx.event.voting_mode.value == "link":
        voter_id, new_cookie = voting_service.new_voter_cookie(settings.secret_key)
        voter = Voter(key=f"anon:{voter_id}", mode=ctx.event.voting_mode)
    if voter is None:
        raise Unauthorized("Sign in or redeem a voting code to vote in this event.")
    voting_service.cast(
        db, ctx.event, project, voter, ip_hash=ip_hash(request), ua_hash=ua_hash(request)
    )
    response = JSONResponse({"vote": _vote_out(ctx.event, project, voter, db)}, status_code=201)
    if new_cookie:
        response.set_cookie(
            VOTER_COOKIE,
            new_cookie,
            httponly=True,
            samesite="lax",
            secure=settings.secure_cookies,
            max_age=60 * 60 * 24 * 90,
            path="/",
        )
    return response

"""Record a vote for a project in the current event.

Args:

code:
def safe_fragment(
    value: object,
    *,
    limit: int = _MAX_FRAGMENT,
    escape_structure: bool = True,
) -> str:
    
    text = str(value)
    text = "".join(
        " " if unicodedata.category(char).startswith("C") else char
        for char in text
    )
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    text = _TOOL_MARKER_RE.sub("#vc‑", text)
    if escape_structure:
        text = text.translate(_STRUCTURAL_CHARS)
    if len(text) > limit:
        text = text[: max(0, limit - 1)].rstrip() + "…"
    return text
comment:
"""Normalize and optionally escape a value for use as a fragment.

Converts *value* to a string, replaces Unicode control characters with
spaces, collapses whitespace, and replaces matching tool markers. When
*escape_structure* is true, translates structural characters using the
configured mapping. If the result exceeds *limit*, truncates it and appends
an ellipsis.

Args:
    value: The value to convert to a fragment.
    limit: The maximum fragment length before truncation.
    escape_structure: Whether to translate structural characters.

Returns:
    The normalized fragment as a string.
"""

def f_Parse_Price(str_price_text):
    MISSING_PRICE = 0.0
    f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    try:
        # convert the text to a number
        f_price = float(str_price_text)
    except ValueError:
        # the text is not a number, keep the default price
        f_price = MISSING_PRICE
    finally:
        # the value is ready, round it to two decimals
        f_price = round(f_price, 2)
    return f_price

code:
class INDstocksAuth:
    

    def __init__(self, cfg: INDstocksConfig):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.cfg.token_cache_path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def refresh_session(self) -> str:
        totp_code = pyotp.TOTP(self.cfg.totp_secret).now()
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{self.cfg.base_url}/generate/token",
            headers={"x-api-key": self.cfg.client_id, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={"mpin": self.cfg.mpin, "totp": totp_code},
            timeout=10,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict):
            token = body["data"]["token"]
        else:
            token = body["token"]
        self._write_cache(token)
        logger.info("INDstocks token refreshed, cached at %s", self.cfg.token_cache_path)
        return token

    def _write_cache(self, token: str) -> None:
        tmp_path = self.cfg.token_cache_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"token": token, "issued_at": time.time()}, f)
        os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
        tmp_path.replace(self.cfg.token_cache_path)  # atomic on POSIX

@router.post(
    "/events/{slug}/projects/{pid}/votes",
    status_code=201,
    dependencies=[Depends(limiter("vote", 30, 60))],
)
def cast_vote(
    request: Request,
    pid: str,
    ctx: EventContext = Depends(load_event),
    voter: Voter | None = Depends(current_voter),
    db: DbSession = Depends(get_db),
    settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings),
):
    
    project = projects_service.get_project(db, ctx.event, pid, ctx.user, organizer=ctx.is_organizer)
    new_cookie = None
    if voter is None and ctx.event.voting_mode.value == "link":
        voter_id, new_cookie = voting_service.new_voter_cookie(settings.secret_key)
        voter = Voter(key=f"anon:{voter_id}", mode=ctx.event.voting_mode)
    if voter is None:
        raise Unauthorized("Sign in or redeem a voting code to vote in this event.")
    voting_service.cast(
        db, ctx.event, project, voter, ip_hash=ip_hash(request), ua_hash=ua_hash(request)
    )
    response = JSONResponse({"vote": _vote_out(ctx.event, project, voter, db)}, status_code=201)
    if new_cookie:
        response.set_cookie(
            VOTER_COOKIE,
            new_cookie,
            httponly=True,
            samesite="lax",
            secure=settings.secure_cookies,
            max_age=60 * 60 * 24 * 90,
            path="/",
        )
    return response
comment:
"""Record a project vote and return its serialized representation.

    Args:
        request: Request used to derive IP and user-agent hashes.
        pid: Identifier of the project to vote for.
        ctx: Event context, including the event and current user.
        voter: Current voter, if one is available.
        db: Database session.
        settings: Application settings used for voter cookies.

    Returns:
        A JSON response with the vote and status code 201. For an anonymous
        link-mode voter, the response also sets a voter cookie.

    Raises:
        Unauthorized: If no voter is available and the event does not create
            an anonymous voter in link mode.

    Side effects:
        Retrieves the project, may create an anonymous voter cookie, and
        records the vote using hashes of the request IP address and user agent.
    """

code:
class INDstocksAuth:
    

    def __init__(self, cfg: INDstocksConfig):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.cfg.token_cache_path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def refresh_session(self) -> str:
        totp_code = pyotp.TOTP(self.cfg.totp_secret).now()
        resp = requests.post(
            f"{self.cfg.base_url}/generate/token",
            headers={"x-api-key": self.cfg.client_id, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            json={"mpin": self.cfg.mpin, "totp": totp_code},
            timeout=10,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict):
            token = body["data"]["token"]
        else:
            token = body["token"]
        self._write_cache(token)
        logger.info("INDstocks token refreshed, cached at %s", self.cfg.token_cache_path)
        return token

    def _write_cache(self, token: str) -> None:
        tmp_path = self.cfg.token_cache_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"token": token, "issued_at": time.time()}, f)
        os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
        tmp_path.replace(self.cfg.token_cache_path)  # atomic on POSIX

code:
def escape_latex(text: str) -> str:
    
    replacements = {
        "\\": r"\textbackslash{}",
        "&": r"\&",
        "%": r"\%",
        "$": r"\$",
        "#": r"\#",
        "_": r"\_",
        "{": r"\{",
        "}": r"\}",
        "~": r"\textasciitilde{}",
        "^": r"\textasciicircum{}",
    }
    for char, escaped in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(char, escaped)
    return text
comment:

def escape_latex(text: str) -> str:
    
    replacements = {
        "\\": r"\textbackslash{}",
        "&": r"\&",
        "%": r"\%",
        "$": r"\$",
        "#": r"\#",
        "_": r"\_",
        "{": r"\{",
        "}": r"\}",
        "~": r"\textasciitilde{}",
        "^": r"\textasciicircum{}",
    }
    for char, escaped in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(char, escaped)
    return text
